Bihar MLC Oath Ceremony: bihar vidhan parishad ke aath navnirvachit sadasyon ne somvar ko pad aur gopniyta ki shapath li. karyakari sabhapti ramavchan ray ne sabhi ko shapath dilaee. samaroh men mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri samet kaee mantri maujud rahe. tejasvi yadav aur prashant kishor bhi karyakram men shamil hue.
